Bug_Title: "toString()" and "clone()" methods should not return null
Bug_Explanation: The toString() method and clone() method are designed to return null under specific conditions, which violates their expected contract of returning a descriptive string and a copy of the object respectively.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases trigger the bug by calling the toString() and clone() methods on a BugDemo object when it is empty, which according to the noncompliant code, returns null. This violates the contract of these methods, and the assertions for non-null values will fail, thereby triggering the bug.
